commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Referee Sascha Stegemann halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Julian Schuster, then shows him a yellow.
90+1' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Yuito Suzuki will be replaced by Igor Matanovic (Freiburg).
90+1' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Substitution. Sael Kumbedi will be replaced by Jan Burger (Wolfsburg).
86' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:8.
85' Freiburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Anthony Jung (Freiburg) receives a yellow card.
82' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
81' Freiburg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
80' Substitution. Patrick Wimmer is replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) for Christian Eriksen.
79' Here is a change. Johan Manzambi is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg).
79' That will be all from Lucas Holer who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
78' 3 - 4 Goal - 3:4! Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the roof of the net. Johan Manzambi provided an assist for the goal.
71' 3 - 3 Jenson Seelt (Wolfsburg) scores an unfortunate own goal after deflecting the ball into his own net!

69' 3 - 2 Goal! Great play by Patrick Wimmer releases Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the right side of the goal. 3:2.
68' Today's match ends for Lovro Majer who will be replaced by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg).
67' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) replacing Philipp Treu.
66' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
66' The ball is cleared after Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Freiburg.
66' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
63' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 56:44.
60' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
59' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
56' 2 - 2 Goal! Kamil Grabara gets a hand on the penalty from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
56' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is going to take the penalty!

55' Jenson Seelt (Wolfsburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sascha Stegemann with no other option than to blow for a foul. PENALTY! One of the players from Freiburg is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
54' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
51' Freiburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Noah Atubolu and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 2:1.
49' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:1.
47' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Patrick Osterhage walks off the pitch to be replaced by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Neat passing move from Wolfsburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
45+2' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
43' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:2.
41' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
41' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
38' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
34' Poor challenge! Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) is penalised for tripping and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle.
34' The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.

33' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
32' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
27' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) received a precise low pass and immediately unleashed a shot on goal. Unfortunately, he only found the left post.
26' Wolfsburg are seeing far more of the ball now.
24' Freiburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
21' Total attempts – 5:1.

19' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
19' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
18' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).
17' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
16' Wolfsburg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
15' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
15' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.

13' 1 - 1 Patrick Wimmer feeds the ball through to Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!
12' Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul after Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
10' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Wolfsburg.
9' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
5' 0 - 1 Philipp Treu (Freiburg) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball into the top right corner. What a special shot.
3' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The Wolfsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
